name: Mitten Extracts | 2g Disposable | Bubblegum Z
description: Sweet nostalgia in every puff, Bubblegum Z takes you back with its candy-like flavor while keeping you grounded with heavy indica effects. Smooth, sugary, and deeply relaxing, this 2g disposable is designed for slow nights, easy mornings, or anytime you want to melt into the moment. With each hit, the flavor sticks around just like your favorite childhood treat—only now with a whole new kind of kick.
